newsitem.title: USA: TCSI says CEO, chairman Strauch resigns.
newsitem.headline: TCSI says CEO, chairman Strauch resigns.

text.p: TCSI Corp said Roger Strauch, chairman and chief executive officer, has resigned from the board and the company effective June 30, 1997.
Dan Miller, a board member, has also resigned. Strauch and Miller, co-founders of TCSI, intend to devote their attention to forming an independent venture firm.

Ram Banin, TCSI's president and chief operating officer, has been appointed chief executive officer and president by the board of directors effective July 1, 1997. He has also been elected to serve on TCSI's board of directors.
